intro: What Rockstar has actually shown or stated about how GTA 6 plays, mostly from the 26-minute Extended Look released in late August 2026. "Shown" means it appeared in official footage or was stated by Rockstar. "Reported" means it comes from press previews or interviews and may change.

sources.title: Red Bull – GTA 6 Extended Look: everything revealed
All Things How – every feature revealed
Dexerto – everything in the Netflix Extended Look
ARY News – Extended Look gameplay upgrades

items.title: Two leads you can swap between
items.text: Jason and Lucia are both playable, and the Extended Look showed switching between them at any time.

items.title: Talking to people, Red Dead style
items.text: An interaction system carried over from Red Dead Redemption 2 lets you talk to the people you meet.

items.title: A long main story
items.text: Previews put the main story at roughly 80 hours. Rockstar hasn't given an official figure.

items.title: Six wanted stars are back
items.text: The maximum wanted level returns to six stars, up from five in GTA V.

items.title: Cover-based gunfights
items.text: Footage shows Jason taking cover behind walls before firing back, inside a skyscraper.

items.title: Slow-motion aiming
items.text: A slowed-down aiming mode highlights enemies' weak spots in red.

items.title: Split health bar
items.text: Health is shown as a split bar rather than one meter.

items.title: Racing of every kind
items.text: Dirt-bike racing, drag racing and track and street races were all shown.

items.title: Diving and base jumping
items.text: Scuba diving and base jumping appear among the side activities.

items.title: Pool, mini-golf and the zoo
items.text: Previews mention pool returning, mini-golf as a new pastime, and a zoo you can visit.

items.title: The gym
items.text: Jason and Lucia can work out, and previews describe visible changes to their bodies.

items.title: Exploring pays off
items.text: Rockstar says the game rewards time spent in the open world, not just rushing between missions.

items.title: Social media in the game
items.text: In-game social media plays a bigger role, with livestream challenges and chat popping up during police chases.

items.title: Music on foot
items.text: Radio and on-demand podcasts keep playing through headphones when you're out of the car.

items.title: Phone-to-phone chat
items.text: One scene shows Jason and Lucia messaging each other.

items.title: No microtransactions in story mode
items.text: Rockstar says single-player launches without microtransactions, and that no generative AI was used to make it.

items.title: Single-player at launch
items.text: Rockstar calls GTA 6 a single-player experience. No online mode has been announced.

items.title: No disc, even in the box
items.text: Physical copies contain a download code, not a disc.

items.title: Not on Game Pass at launch
items.text: Take-Two has said GTA 6 won't be on Xbox Game Pass at launch.
